text:
maria: Quick sketch idea  build a single waterfall visual that stacks p50/p95/p99 latency bars for each model+config and overlays unit cost ($/1k tokens). one hero for the webinar, one simpler static for the blog.

alex: Agree. show hosted vs dedicated side-by-side and add a tiny $ panel converting unit cost into monthly bills (e.g., 1M / 10M tokens). makes it concrete. :moneybag: 

sam: Data request to runtime: CSV with model, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, cost_per_1k_usd, cache_on, deploy_type. benchbot: linked run 6161 -> https://bench.internal/runs/6161/summary (CSV attached).

benchbot: run_id=6161, models=[redwood-small, redwood-med, open-xl], fields included as requested.

jordan: Recommend a dashed fallback trace showing routing to a lighter model under heavy tail pressure. that supports our graceful-degradation positioning. also annotate where batching/prefix cache reduce p95 -> p50.
liv: Draft headlines (fresh wording):
- "Real production tradeoffs: latency and token economics"
- "Shrink the tail, not the wallet"
- "Benchmarks that turn latency into dollars"
Which should be the hero?
alex: "Shrink the tail, not the wallet" for paid; punchy and benefit-led. use the others for organic and webinar copy.
maria: Deliverables: (1) Hero waterfall slide (PNG + editable fig) (2) Social static + 3 short copy variants for A/B (3) Landing blurb + signup routing rules. Routing: if product_interest=Dedicated OR (company_size >= 200 AND product_interest!=Hosted) -> SDR; else -> marketing nurture. Keep routing simple.
jordan: Form: radio choices Hosted / Dedicated / Unsure. If Unsure + company_size >=200 -> SDR. Add hidden tag for "Dedicated_interest" to trigger AE slack alert.
sam: Figma callouts: X labels: [redwood-small, redwood-med, open-xl]; stacked colors: p50=light blue, p95=teal, p99=navy; overlay cost line orange on right axis. callouts: "Prefix cache -> ~2x cost reduction", "Fallback to lightweight model at p99".
liv: Social copy variants:
A: "See how routing and caching cut tail latency  and lower token bills. Join our live demo."
B: "Production latency vs price: real numbers from Redwood Inference."
C: "Latency, batching, caching  real-world tradeoffs and cost impact."
alex: A for paid, B for organic, C for webinar description.
maria: Timeline: need final assets by Wednesday EOD for Thursday AM send. Owners: sam = CSV + fig + first PNG, liv = copy + image exports, alex = landing + form routing, jordan = SDR mapping + AE alert.
sam: I'll post the CSV and a first PNG by Tuesday EOD.
liv: I'll drop the final copy into #content-review Wednesday morning.
alex: I'll wire the form and add tags; will ping for staging QA.
jordan: Compliance wants a short footnote: "Benchmarks run in controlled environment; results may vary by workload." add small gray text under the chart.
maria: One-sentence explainer for landing under the chart: "We measured latency and unit cost across common configs  see how batching, caching, and routing change real-world economics." keep plain language.
liv: Once copy is in #content-review I'll shepherd approvals. thanks team. :rocket:
